definitions.name: serialize_result
definitions.documentation: The exact byte form written to ``result.json`` (hashed content).

definitions.name: serialize_snapshot
definitions.documentation: The exact byte form written to ``pubchem_snapshot.json``.

definitions.name: _write_json
definitions.documentation: Write deterministic (sorted, indented, no trailing newline) JSON.

definitions.name: _stamp
definitions.documentation: Display timestamps in UTC, Mountain and Eastern time (not hashed).

definitions.name: _parse_formula
definitions.documentation: Parse ``H2O``/``NaCl`` into {element: count}, or None when not a formula.

definitions.name: _hill_formula
definitions.documentation: Hill system formula: C first, H second, remaining elements alphabetically.

definitions.name: _single_atom_smiles
definitions.documentation: Canonical SMILES of a single neutral heavy atom (implicit hydrogens).

definitions.name: _formula_to_smiles
definitions.documentation: Resolve a parsed formula to canonical SMILES, or None when not covered.

definitions.name: _canonical_smiles
definitions.documentation: Canonical isomeric SMILES of a sanitized molecule (explicit H folded).

definitions.name: resolve_start
definitions.documentation:
Resolve a start written in any notation to canonical SMILES.

Delegates to ``engineering_sim.science.chem_input.resolve`` (2026-09-14 review), which accepts SMILES, a
formula (``H2O``, ``H₂O``, ``H_2O``, LaTeX-decorated), a name, InChI, InChIKey or a CAS number, and
can be forced with a prefix (``smiles:CO`` vs ``formula:CO``). Every notation for one molecule gives
the same canonical SMILES, so the recipe id is identical whichever way the user types the start.
Multi-fragment starts (salts such as ``NaCl``) are rejected: the edit search walks one connected graph.
The portable exported harness vendors chem_input, so this import also works outside the checkout.

definitions.name: resolve_start_detail
definitions.documentation: Same resolution, but returns the full record (smiles, via, PubChem cid/name) for the page.

definitions.name: normalise_recipe
definitions.documentation:
Fill defaults and validate; return the recipe with its computed ``recipe_id``.

``start`` is stored as the canonical SMILES of the resolved start, so ``H2O``,
``water`` and ``O`` produce the same recipe. ``rdkit_version`` is always taken
from the running RDKit, never from user input.

definitions.name: _recipe_id
definitions.documentation: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the recipe without its own ``recipe_id``.

definitions.name: default_recipe
definitions.documentation: The default recipe (canonical contract), normalised and with its ``recipe_id``.

definitions.name: _sanitize
definitions.documentation: Return a freshly sanitized copy, or None when RDKit rejects the valence.

definitions.name: _apply_moves
definitions.documentation:
Yield ``(edited_rwmol, move_name, detail)`` for every move in a fixed order.

Ordering is the determinism contract: atom index order, then element order as
listed in the recipe, then bond order 1 -> 2 -> 3. Radicals only when
``allow_radicals`` is true; charge moves respect ``max_charge``.

definitions.name: _valid
definitions.documentation: Single connected fragment within the recipe's element/charge/radical limits.

definitions.name: _search
definitions.documentation:
Breadth-first edit search; returns (found, generated, valence_valid).

``found`` is a list of ``{smiles, distance, path, mol}`` in deterministic
first-discovery order. ``generated`` counts every candidate produced by a
move; ``valence_valid`` counts those that RDKit sanitizes — it is a raw
candidate count, taken before canonical-SMILES deduplication and before the
recipe checks in ``_valid`` (2026-09-15: clarified after a complete distance-2
run on H2O reported 16,234 sanitizing candidates for 7,143 distinct compounds;
the same structure is reached by many different edit paths). The number of
distinct compounds is ``counts['returned']`` / ``len(neighbours)``.

definitions.name: _composition
definitions.documentation: Element counts including implicit hydrogens, {element: count}.

definitions.name: _count_tanimoto
definitions.documentation:
Tanimoto on two count-vector numpy arrays (sum min / sum max).

Returns None when both fingerprints are empty (denominator zero), which is
the signal for the element-count fallback.

definitions.name: _element_count_tanimoto
definitions.documentation: Sum(min)/sum(max) over element counts (hydrogens included).

definitions.name: _similarity_raw
definitions.documentation:
Return (similarity, method) with the atom-pair count Tanimoto and fallback.

An atom-pair fingerprint is empty for a molecule with fewer than two heavy
atoms, so when either side is empty we fall back to the documented
element-count Tanimoto (hydrogens included).

definitions.name: similarity
definitions.documentation: Public similarity between two SMILES, returned as a ``derived`` value record.

definitions.name: _thermo_gas_index
definitions.documentation: {composition_tuple: sorted gas-phase species keys} built once from thermo data.

definitions.name: _thermo_gas_key
definitions.documentation: First gas-phase species key for a composition, or None.

definitions.name: _balance
definitions.documentation:
Deterministic small-coefficient balance of ``a*S + b*L -> c*N + d*R``.

Search order (documented): no partner, then one left partner, then one right
partner, then both; within a case partners follow the recipe list and
coefficients ascend. Returns ``(a, b, L_index, c, d, R_index)`` or None.

definitions.name: _reaction_for
definitions.documentation: Return ``(reaction_dict, favored_bool_or_None)`` for start -> neighbour.

definitions.name: _pubchem_batch
definitions.documentation:
Batch resolve InChIKeys via the property/InChIKey endpoint (min CID per key).

The plain ``/inchikey/cids`` batch endpoint returns a flat, unmappable CID list
(isotopologues are interleaved with canonical entries), so the harness batches
through the ``property/InChIKey`` endpoint instead and takes the minimum CID per
InChIKey — the canonical, non-isotopic PubChem entry. A 404 on a chunk means the
whole chunk was not found (hypothetical), not a rejection.

definitions.name: _pubchem_get
definitions.documentation: Per-key GET fallback; returns {'cid': int|None} (minimum CID, 404 = not found).

definitions.name: _known_check
definitions.documentation:
Resolve known/hypothetical for a list of InChIKeys.

Returns ``(status, snapshot_out, note)`` where ``status[k]`` is one of
``'known'`` (with a CID), ``'hypothetical'`` (PubChem confirmed not found) or
``'unknown'`` (network failure / offline without a snapshot). The snapshot
records each PubChem decision as ``{inchikey: {'cid': int|None}}``; a missing
key means the decision could not be made.

definitions.name: _rank_key
definitions.documentation:
Deterministic ranking key: distance asc, similarity desc, favored desc,
known desc, canonical smiles asc. (Unavailable booleans sort as False.)

definitions.name: _cid_record
definitions.documentation: A cited PubChem CID value record (no timestamp, so it stays hash-stable).

definitions.name: compute
definitions.documentation:
Deterministic core: search, rank, annotate. Returns (result, snapshot, notes).

``recipe`` must already be normalised (see ``normalise_recipe``): ``start`` is
canonical SMILES and every field is present. ``snapshot`` is a previously
saved ``pubchem_snapshot.json`` dict; when given (or when ``allow_network`` is
False) no network calls are made.

definitions.name: run
definitions.documentation:
Run a recipe end-to-end: normalise, compute, write the run folder.

``replay=True`` reuses a saved snapshot (no network). Returns
``{recipe, run, result}``.

definitions.name: verify

definitions.name: main
definitions.documentation: Parse the global --data flag, re-exec under the venv if needed, then dispatch.

coverage: Packaged implementation; no direct test reference found.

definitions.name: stream_mix
definitions.documentation:
Adiabatic mixing of process streams: mass balance + energy balance.

Each stream is a dict:
  name   (str)               — label
  m_dot  (float, kg/s)       — mass flow
  T_K    (float)             — inlet temperature
  cp     (float, J/(kg K))   — constant specific heat, OR
  fluid  (str)               — CoolProp fluid name (cp evaluated at the inlet T)
  P_Pa   (float)             — pressure for the CoolProp cp lookup (default 1e5)
  species (dict {name: mass fraction}) — for the component mass balance

The mixing temperature uses a constant-cp energy balance,
    T_mix = sum(m_dot_i * cp_i * T_i) / sum(m_dot_i * cp_i),
with cp_i either the given constant or CoolProp's cp at the inlet temperature
(not iterated to the mix temperature — a first-order estimate).

definitions.name: _raoult_K
definitions.documentation: K_i = P_sat_i(T)/P from Antoine data where available (Raoult's law, ideal gas).

definitions.name: flash_rachford_rice
definitions.documentation:
Two-phase flash: vapour fraction V and the liquid (x) / vapour (y) compositions.

Rachford-Rice equation
    sum_i z_i (K_i - 1) / (1 + (K_i - 1) V) = 0
solved for V in [0, 1]. K-values may be given directly (``K`` dict) or computed
from Raoult's law with Antoine vapour pressures (``T_K``, ``P_Pa``; only water
is bundled). ``z`` is the feed mole-fraction dict (normalised here).

definitions.name: reactor_sizing
definitions.signature: kind='CSTR', k=None, order=1, X=None, F_A0=None, C_A0=None
definitions.documentation:
Isothermal reactor volume for a CSTR or PFR, plus the Damkoehler number.

Design equations for rate = k * C_A^n = k * C_A0^n * (1-X)^n:
  CSTR  V = F_A0 X / [k C_A0^n (1-X)^n]
  PFR   V = F_A0/(k C_A0^n) * { -ln(1-X)              (n = 1)
                                 [(1-X)^(1-n) - 1]/(n-1)  (n != 1) }
Da = (inlet rate) * V / F_A0; tau = V C_A0 / F_A0.

Units: F_A0 [mol/s], C_A0 [mol/m3], k [(mol/m3)^(1-n) / s], V [m3].

definitions.name: heat_duty
definitions.documentation: Sensible heat duty Q = m_dot * cp * dT [W].

definitions.name: lmtd
definitions.documentation:
Log-mean temperature difference for a heat exchanger.

counter:  dT1 = Th_in - Tc_out,  dT2 = Th_out - Tc_in
parallel: dT1 = Th_in - Tc_in,   dT2 = Th_out - Tc_out
LMTD = (dT1 - dT2) / ln(dT1 / dT2).

coverage: Test-text reference only; not measured branch/function coverage.

definitions.name: _cite
definitions.documentation: One ``estimated`` cite record naming the model and mechanism.

definitions.name: _cite_none
definitions.documentation: A ``None``-valued estimated record for a quantity that did not occur.

definitions.name: mechanisms
definitions.documentation:
Bundled Cantera mechanisms with species/reaction counts and references.

Counts are measured from the installed files at call time; metadata (label,
reference, validity, homogeneous-gas capability) is transcribed from each file's
own header. The list is sorted by mechanism name for determinism.

definitions.name: _load_gas
definitions.documentation:
Load ``mech`` as a homogeneous ideal-gas Solution, or raise with the reason.

Guards against surface mechanisms, real-gas (Redlich-Kwong) mechanisms and
mechanisms with no gas-phase reactions, all of which the ideal-gas 0-D reactor
and freely-propagating flame tools cannot use.

definitions.name: _mole_fractions
definitions.documentation:
Map a ``{species: amount}`` dict to mole fractions (amounts normalised to 1).

Accepts either relative mole numbers ({"H2": 2, "O2": 1}) or already-normalised
fractions ({"H2": 0.667, "O2": 0.333}) — both give the same result.

definitions.name: _major_indices
definitions.documentation: Species indices with the largest peak mole fraction, most prominent first.

definitions.name: _notes
definitions.documentation: Common honesty notes: model class + mechanism validity + what is not modelled.

definitions.name: _equilibrium_composition
definitions.documentation: Major species of an equilibrated Solution, most abundant first, as cite records.

definitions.name: ignition
definitions.signature: mech, mixture, T0_K, P_bar, t_end_s, reactor='const_pressure'
definitions.documentation:
0-D adiabatic ignition: temperature, pressure and species vs time.

Parameters
----------
mech : str
    Mechanism name from ``mechanisms()`` (homogeneous ideal-gas only).
mixture : dict
    ``{species: amount}`` (amounts normalised to mole fractions).
T0_K, P_bar : float
    Initial temperature (K) and pressure (bar).
t_end_s : float
    Integration window (s). Refused above ``MAX_T_END_S`` (10 s).
reactor : str
    ``'const_pressure'`` or ``'const_volume'``.

Returns ignition delay from two independent criteria (time of maximum dT/dt and
time of the OH mole-fraction peak), the final equilibrium state, major-species
time series (<= 400 samples) and a ``happens_within`` boolean.

definitions.name: equilibrate
definitions.documentation:
Equilibrium composition; ``constraint='HP'`` gives the adiabatic flame temperature.

``constraint`` is ``'TP'`` (fixed T, P), ``'HP'`` (fixed enthalpy, P — adiabatic
flame temperature) or ``'UV'`` (fixed internal energy, volume — constant-volume
explosion temperature).

definitions.name: flame_speed
definitions.signature: mech, fuel, oxidizer, phi, T0_K, P_bar
definitions.documentation:
Freely-propagating 1-D premixed flame: laminar flame speed S_L (cm/s) + profiles.

``oxidizer`` uses Cantera's ``set_equivalence_ratio`` syntax (e.g. ``'O2:1, N2:3.76'``).
``phi`` is bounded to [0.4, 3.0]; the grid is refined with
``set_refine_criteria(ratio=3, slope=0.07, curve=0.14)``.

definitions.name: rate_screen
definitions.documentation:
Top 10 reactions by |net rate of progress| at a state, with rate constants.

In a radical-free (frozen) mixture the net rate of progress is ~0 because forward
and reverse rates balance; the forward rate of progress and rate constants are
reported alongside so the fastest possible channels are still visible.

definitions.name: bench_kinetics
definitions.documentation:
Map My Lab items into a mechanism and ask: does the mixture react within ``t_s``?

Accepts the My Lab item syntax (e.g. ``["2 H2", "O2"]``); every item is resolved
by ``chem.parse_items`` and mapped onto a mechanism species. When any item cannot
be mapped the result is ``{"covered": False, "missing": [...]}`` rather than a
guess. Otherwise the mixture is run in a 0-D adiabatic constant-pressure reactor
and ``happens`` is True when it reaches >= 50 % of its equilibrium conversion
within ``t_s`` (e.g. H2/O2 at 300 K for 1 h -> no; at 1100 K -> ignites in ms).

coverage: Test-text reference only; not measured branch/function coverage.

definitions.name: _eos
definitions.documentation: Reference equation of state for a pure fluid, from CoolProp's own metadata.

definitions.name: _cite
definitions.documentation: One ``estimated`` record naming CoolProp and the fluid's reference EOS.

definitions.name: fluids
definitions.documentation: Sorted list of the pure fluids and mixtures CoolProp can model.

definitions.name: _inputs
definitions.documentation: Validate and extract exactly two state-defining inputs from a key dict.

definitions.name: _phase
definitions.documentation: Phase label (liquid/gas/twophase/supercritical/...) from CoolProp.

definitions.name: _quality
definitions.signature: fluid, phase, n1, v1, n2, v2
definitions.documentation: Vapour quality: 0 liquid / 1 gas / 0..1 two-phase / None supercritical.

definitions.name: state
definitions.documentation:
Full property set at a thermodynamic state defined by two of T/P/Q/H/S/D.

``inputs`` keys are ``T_K``, ``P_Pa``, ``Q``, ``H`` (J/kg), ``S`` (J/(kg K)),
``D`` (kg/m3); exactly two are required.

definitions.name: saturation
definitions.documentation:
Saturated liquid/vapour properties at a given temperature or pressure.

Exactly one of ``T_K`` / ``P_Pa`` defines the saturation point; the other is
computed by CoolProp (quality 0). Liquid and vapour properties are returned
side by side.

definitions.name: phase_envelope
definitions.documentation:
T-P saturation curve from the triple point to the critical point (<= 200 pts).

Points are plain ``[T_K, P_Pa]`` pairs for plotting; the critical and triple
points are also returned as cite records.

definitions.name: mixture_bubble_dew
definitions.documentation:
Bubble and dew temperatures of a HEOS mixture at a fixed pressure.

``components`` is a list of CoolProp fluid names; ``fractions`` their mole
fractions (must sum to 1). Unsupported pairs are refused with CoolProp's reason.

coverage: Test-text reference only; not measured branch/function coverage.

definitions.name: atomic_masses
definitions.documentation:
Standard atomic masses (amu) for the elements science toolkit can parse.

Most-abundant-isotope masses (rounded), from the standard tables of atomic
weights (CIAAW 2021). Not fetched during this build, so downstream rotational
constants cite them as ``unverified`` approximations rather than ``cited``.

definitions.name: _heavy_count
definitions.documentation: Number of atoms with Z > 1.

definitions.name: _estimate_n_basis
definitions.documentation:
Quick upper estimate of the contracted basis size, before building the Mole.

Rough per-atom counts for the four supported bases (enough to refuse oversize
inputs early; the exact ``mol.nao`` is checked after the Mole is built).

definitions.name: resolve_geometry
definitions.documentation:
Resolve a query into atoms/charge/spin for a PySCF calculation.

``preopt='xtb'`` relaxes the geometry with GFN2-xTB (tblite) first, which is
more robust for radicals and unusual valences; otherwise the RDKit ETKDG+MMFF
geometry from ``chem.molecule`` is used unchanged. Returns a dict with
``atoms`` ([{el,x,y,z}], Angstrom), ``charge``, ``spin_mult`` (2S+1),
``smiles``, ``formula``, and a ``notes`` list.

definitions.name: _numbers_of
definitions.documentation: Atomic numbers of a SMILES (with hydrogens added), matching xtb.estimate's order.

definitions.name: _sym
definitions.documentation: Element symbol from atomic number.

definitions.name: atoms_to_atom_string
definitions.documentation: PySCF atom string ('El x y z; ...') from [{el,x,y,z}] (Angstrom).

definitions.name: _make_mf
definitions.documentation: Build the mean-field object for a method/spin; RHF auto-upgrades to UHF for open shells.

definitions.name: _opt_method_label
definitions.documentation: The method actually used (after RHF->UHF upgrade for open shells).

definitions.name: _optimize_geometry
definitions.documentation:
Optimise the geometry with scipy BFGS on PySCF analytic gradients.

pyscf.geomopt requires the optional `geometric`/`berny` packages, which are not
installed in this venv; a deterministic scipy BFGS over Cartesian coordinates
with analytic gradients is used instead (reported honestly in the result).

definitions.name: _orbitals
definitions.documentation:
Normalised list of (energy_eV, occupation) for every MO, energy-ordered.

UHF/UKS return alpha/beta arrays; they are concatenated into one list. Sorted
by energy so the HOMO/LUMO assignment and the page diagram are deterministic.

definitions.name: _homo_lumo
definitions.documentation: (homo, lumo) indices into the sorted orbital list, or (None, None).

definitions.name: _lowdin_charges
definitions.documentation:
Lowdin charges: q_A = Z_A - sum_i (S^{1/2} D S^{1/2})_{ii} over A's AOs.

``aoslice_by_atom()`` returns [p0, p1, c0, c1] per atom where ``c0:c1`` are the
contracted-AO indices of that atom (``p0:p1`` are shell indices, not AOs).

definitions.name: _density
definitions.documentation: Total (alpha+beta) density matrix.

definitions.name: _charges
definitions.documentation: (mulliken, lowdin) per-atom charge arrays; either may be None if unavailable.

definitions.name: _dipole_debye
definitions.documentation: |dipole| in Debye (None if it cannot be computed).

definitions.name: run_scf
definitions.signature: atoms, charge, spin_mult, method='RHF', basis='sto-3g', optimize=False, max_steps=50
definitions.documentation:
Run one SCF calculation on an explicit atom list.

Parameters
----------
atoms : list of {el, x, y, z} (Angstrom)
charge : int
spin_mult : int (2S+1)
method : 'RHF' | 'UHF' | 'B3LYP' | 'PBE0' | 'wB97X-D'
basis : 'sto-3g' | '6-31g*' | 'def2-svp' | 'cc-pvdz'
optimize : run a geometry optimisation first (scipy BFGS, analytic gradients)

Returns a dict of cite records; raises ValueError for oversize inputs.

definitions.name: _formula
definitions.documentation: Hill formula from an atom symbol list (H/C first, then alphabetical).

definitions.name: scf
definitions.documentation: Query-facing SCF wrapper: resolve geometry, then :func:`run_scf`.

definitions.name: _march
definitions.documentation:
Marching tetrahedra over a cubic scalar grid; returns (vertices, triangles).

Each cube is split into 6 tetrahedra around its 0-7 body diagonal (the standard
crack-free decomposition). Edge crossings are cached by the pair of grid-point
linear indices so adjacent tetrahedra share vertices (watertight mesh).

definitions.name: _cap_triangles
definitions.documentation: Deterministic uniform stride of triangles down to ``cap`` (keeps the surface sparse).

definitions.name: orbital_cube
definitions.signature: query, orbital='HOMO', method='RHF', basis='sto-3g', grid=40, isovalue=0.05
definitions.documentation:
Evaluate one MO on a grid and return ± isosurface meshes for the page viewer.

The AO values are evaluated with ``pyscf.dft.numint.eval_ao`` and the surface is
extracted with the module's own marching-tetrahedra (skimage is not installed).
Triangles are capped at 60 000 across both lobes. Coordinates are Angstrom to
overlay directly on the ball-and-stick molecule.

definitions.name: bond_dissociation
definitions.documentation:
Homolytic bond-dissociation energy: E(A) + E(B) - E(AB), optional ZPE correction.

``fragments`` is a list of two fragment queries. Geometries are the RDKit
ETKDG+MMFF structures; when ``with_zpe`` is requested the zero-point energy of
each species is computed from B3LYP/6-31G* harmonic frequencies (the same method
as :mod:`chemphys_spectra`). D0 = De - ΔZPE. All energies are estimates.

coverage: Test-text reference only; not measured branch/function coverage.

definitions.name: _scale_record
definitions.documentation:
Vibrational frequency scale factor record for a method/basis.

The CCCBDB page that tabulates these factors is a JS form and was not
retrievable as a static table during this build, so the value is ``unverified``
rather than ``cited`` (honest per the module contract).

definitions.name: _lorentzian
definitions.documentation: Lorentzian lineshape (normalised to 1 at peak).

definitions.name: _gaussian
definitions.documentation: Gaussian lineshape (normalised to 1 at peak).

definitions.name: _spectrum_curve
definitions.signature: freqs, intensities, xmin, xmax, npts, broadening, shape
definitions.documentation: Sum of broadened peaks on a uniform grid; returns (x, y) lists.

definitions.name: _frequencies_pyscf
definitions.documentation:
Harmonic frequencies + IR intensities from a PySCF analytical Hessian.

Intensities come from a finite-difference dipole derivative projected onto the
mass-weighted normal modes; they are relative (arbitrary units), not absolute
km/mol. Returns None for intensities when skipped (molecule too large).

definitions.name: _dipole_derivative_pyscf
definitions.documentation:
Finite-difference dipole derivative dmu/dR (Debye/Angstrom), shape (3N, 3).

Two SCF runs per coordinate (+-delta); the converged density is reused as the
initial guess so the displaced runs converge in a few cycles.

definitions.name: _dipole
definitions.documentation: |dipole vector| as a numpy array in Debye (zeros if unavailable).

definitions.name: _intensities_from_dipole_derivative
definitions.documentation:
Project the dipole derivative onto mass-weighted normal modes -> relative |dmu/dQ|^2.

pyscf ``norm_mode`` has shape (n_modes, n_atoms, 3); dmu/dQ_k =
sum_{a,d} (dmu/dR_{a,d}) * L[k, a, d] / sqrt(m_a).

definitions.name: _is_linear
definitions.documentation: True when all atoms are collinear (a linear rotor has 5 zero modes, else 6).

definitions.name: _frequencies_xtb
definitions.documentation:
Harmonic frequencies from a GFN2-xTB finite-difference Hessian (step 0.005 A).

The mass-weighted Hessian is built from central differences of tblite gradients
(3N coordinate displacements, 2 single points each), symmetrised, and
diagonalised. Frequencies are unscaled (no standard xTB scale factor).

definitions.name: ir
definitions.signature: query, method='B3LYP', basis='6-31g*', intensities=True, fwhm=20.0, xmin=400.0, xmax=4000.0
definitions.documentation:
Harmonic IR spectrum: scaled frequencies, Lorentzian-broadened stick/curve.

``method='GFN2-xTB'`` uses the tblite finite-difference Hessian (unscaled);
any other method uses the PySCF analytical Hessian with ``basis``. Returns
frequency/intensity lists and the sampled spectrum curve.

definitions.name: zpe
definitions.documentation: Zero-point energy (kJ/mol) from scaled harmonic frequencies: ZPE = 0.5 * h c * sum(nu).

definitions.name: uv_vis
definitions.documentation:
TDDFT vertical excitation energies and oscillator strengths (Gaussian spectrum).

Small basis sets make TDDFT energies qualitative; the note says so. nstates is
capped at 40 and the oscillator-strength extraction is defensive (falls back to
zero when pyscf's transition-dipole helper is unavailable).

definitions.name: _symmetry_number
definitions.documentation:
Symmetry number sigma for the rigid-rotor partition function.

Linear molecules: 2 if homonuclear (all atoms identical), else 1. Non-linear:
PySCF point-group detection with a mapping to the order of the proper-rotation
subgroup; falls back to 1 (with a note) when detection is unavailable.

definitions.name: rotational
definitions.documentation:
Principal moments of inertia, rotational constants (cm^-1, GHz), symmetry number.

Uses standard (most-abundant-isotope) atomic masses, cited ``unverified`` since
the mass table was not fetched during this build. The rigid-rotor constant
B = h/(8 pi^2 c I) is computed with CODATA constants (fetched).

from .chemphys_statmech import A0, C_LIGHT, E_H, H_PLANCK, N_A, U_AMU
from pyscf import dft, gto, tdscf

definitions.name: constants
definitions.documentation: CODATA physical constants used by the area, each a cited value record.

definitions.name: particle_in_box
definitions.documentation:
Particle-in-a-box levels E_n = n^2 h^2 / (8 m L^2) in eV (n = 1..n_max).

The energies scale exactly as n^2. Default mass is the electron, length L in nm.

definitions.name: harmonic_oscillator
definitions.documentation: Harmonic-oscillator levels E_n = h c nu (n + 1/2) in eV (equally spaced).

definitions.name: hydrogen_atom
definitions.documentation: Hydrogen-atom levels E_n = -Rydberg / n^2 in eV (Rydberg from CODATA).

definitions.name: boltzmann
definitions.documentation:
Relative Boltzmann populations p_i ∝ g_i exp(-E_i / kT), normalised to sum 1.

``levels_eV`` is a list of levels; each may be a bare float (eV), a cite value
record ``{value, ...}``, or a dict ``{energy_eV, degeneracy}`` (degeneracy
defaults to 1).

definitions.name: photon
definitions.documentation: Convert between photon energy (eV), wavelength (nm) and frequency (Hz) via E = h nu = h c / lambda.

definitions.name: blackbody
definitions.documentation: Wien peak wavelength/frequency and photon energy for a blackbody at T_K.

definitions.name: _rrho_contributions
definitions.signature: mass_kg, sigma, rot_consts_cm1, linear, freqs_cm1, multiplicity, T, P_pa
definitions.documentation:
S/Cp/H-H0/G-H0 contributions (per mole) for the RRHO ideal-gas model.

Translational (Sackur-Tetrode), rotational (rigid rotor, sigma symmetry number),
vibrational (harmonic oscillators) and electronic (spin multiplicity g=2S+1).
Returns a dict of per-term dicts {s (J/mol*K), cp (J/mol*K), h_h0 (kJ/mol),
g_h0 (kJ/mol)} plus totals.

definitions.name: _resolve_rr_inputs
definitions.documentation:
Resolve mass/geometry/symmetry/rotational constants/frequencies for a query.

``freqs`` (cm^-1), ``rot`` ({A,B,C} cm^-1) and ``spin`` (multiplicity 2S+1) override
the computed values when given; otherwise they come from a B3LYP/6-31g* hessian and
the rigid-rotor geometry. Symmetry number and linearity always come from the geometry.

definitions.name: partition_functions
definitions.signature: query, T_K=298.15, P_bar=1.0, freqs=None, rot=None, spin=None
definitions.documentation:
RRHO partition-function contributions for a molecule at T, P.

Returns per-term and total S (J/mol*K), Cp (J/mol*K), H-H0 and G-H0 (kJ/mol).
All contributions are ``derived`` from the stated inputs; the totals carry a
``estimated`` record naming the model and its assumptions.

definitions.name: statmech
definitions.documentation: End-to-end RRHO thermodynamics for a query (frequencies/rotational constants from QM).

definitions.name: _diatomic_records
definitions.documentation: Cited value records for one diatomic's constants (verified when fetched).

definitions.name: compare_nist
definitions.documentation:
Compare RRHO S and Cp with NIST Shomate values (``thermo.props``).

For diatomics with tabulated constants (N2, CO, O2, ...) the RRHO inputs are the
cited equilibrium constants; for other species they are computed from a
B3LYP/6-31g* calculation (with a note that the comparison is then approximate).

coverage: Test-text reference only; not measured branch/function coverage.

definitions.name: today
definitions.documentation: UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a citation's `retrieved` field.

definitions.name: value
definitions.signature: v, unit, kind, source=None, retrieved=None, verified=False, method=None, note=None, uncertainty=None
definitions.documentation: Build one value record; raises on an unknown kind or a cited value without a source.

definitions.name: num
definitions.documentation: Plain number from a value record (or pass a bare number through).

coverage: Test-text reference only; not measured branch/function coverage.

definitions.name: library
definitions.documentation: Records for one library: 'resins' | 'additives' | 'fillers' | 'thermosets'.

definitions.name: _num
definitions.documentation: Plain number from a cite record or bare number.

definitions.name: hydrolysis
definitions.signature: iv0, moisture_ppm, reacted_fraction, cooh0, K, a
definitions.documentation:
One scission per reacted water for a condensation resin with Mark-Houwink K, a.

Mirrors rpet.hydrolysis so that with the PET constants (K=2.1e-4, a=0.82,
M_water 18.015) the result is bit-identical. 1/Mn = 1/Mn0 + scissions/M_water,
scissions = moisture_ppm * reacted_fraction / M_water in mmol/kg.

definitions.name: halpin_tsai_longitudinal
definitions.documentation:
Halpin-Tsai longitudinal modulus for aligned short fibres, E in GPa.

E_c = E_m (1 + xi*eta*vf) / (1 - eta*vf),  xi = 2*(l/d),  eta = (Ef/Em - 1)/(Ef/Em + xi).
For in-plane random fibres the laminate average (3/8 E_L + 5/8 E_T) is lower;
this returns the aligned upper reference.

definitions.name: _is_transparent
definitions.documentation: Amorphous-transparent capability from the clarity text (crude but deterministic).

definitions.name: _hdt_ceiling_c
definitions.documentation:
HDT-A (1.8 MPa) ceiling: Tg-limited for amorphous, ~Tm-20 C for reinforced semicrystalline.

Unfilled semicrystalline HDT-A is the datasheet value; 30 % glass pushes it toward
but not past Tm (empirical ceiling Tm - 20 C).

definitions.name: screen
_antagonism_findings
definitions.documentation: Findings for any documented antagonism whose trigger and victim are both present.

definitions.name: alternatives
definitions.documentation:
Rank resins (unfilled and 30 % glass) against targets using library ceilings.

Returns a dict: 'passing' (resins meeting every target), 'results' (one entry per
resin with per-target verdicts and a reason), and 'summary'. The reason for a
rejected resin names the governing limit (Tg, Tm/crystallinity, clarity, tensile).

definitions.name: _alternatives_summary
definitions.documentation: One-line verdict; names Tg and crystallinity when that is the governing conflict.

coverage: Test-text reference only; not measured branch/function coverage.

definitions.name: _ad4_type
definitions.documentation: AutoDock4 atom type for one RDKit atom (documented heuristic).

definitions.name: _build_receptor_rdkit
definitions.documentation:
Build an RDKit molecule (all single bonds) from a PDBFixer topology.

Returns the sanitized molecule with Gasteiger charges computed. Over-valent
nitrogens (protonated N-termini) are given a +1 formal charge so RDKit can
sanitize; this does not change Gasteiger's electronegativity-based charges.

definitions.name: _write_receptor_pdbqt
definitions.documentation:
Write the receptor PDBQT (minimal writer: AD4 types + Gasteiger charges).

Returns (n_atoms, n_hydrogens). Line format matches Meeko's PDBQT writer so
the Vina parser reads it exactly as it reads Meeko output.

definitions.name: _prepare_receptor
definitions.documentation: Prepare the receptor PDBQT file; returns (pdbqt_path, n_atoms, n_hydrogens).

definitions.name: _hetero_codes
definitions.documentation: Set of non-water hetero-group codes present in the structure.

definitions.name: _ligand_from_hetero
definitions.documentation:
Prepare a ligand from a hetero group in the structure (crystal coordinates).

Returns (pdbqt_string, is_crystal=True). Raises ValueError if the code is absent.

definitions.name: _meeko_pdbqt
definitions.documentation: Add hydrogens and run Meeko preparation; return (pdbqt_string, is_crystal).

definitions.name: _ligand_from_smiles
definitions.documentation: Prepare a ligand from SMILES (RDKit 3D embed -> Meeko).

definitions.name: _resolve_ligand
definitions.documentation: Interpret the ligand argument: hetero code -> crystal, else SMILES, else PubChem name.

definitions.name: _ligand_box
definitions.documentation: Box from a hetero group: centroid center, extent + 8 Å (min 16 Å per side).

definitions.name: _crystal_heavy_atoms
definitions.documentation: Heavy atoms [(element, x, y, z)] of the first instance of a hetero group (reference pose for redocking).

definitions.name: _rmsd_to_reference
definitions.documentation:
Heavy-atom RMSD (Å) of a docked pose to the crystal ligand, in the receptor frame (no superposition).

Symmetry handling: within each element the pose-to-reference atom correspondence is the minimum-cost
assignment on squared distance (scipy linear_sum_assignment), so equivalent atoms (e.g. a flipped phenyl)
are not penalised. That makes the value a lower bound on the graph-isomorphism RMSD; it is None when the
heavy-atom element counts differ (different protonation/tautomer handling or a partial crystal ligand).

definitions.name: _parse_poses
definitions.documentation:
Parse Vina's poses() PDBQT into per-pose {affinity, rmsd_lb, rmsd_ub, atoms}.

rmsd_lb/rmsd_ub are Vina's RMSDs relative to the best pose of this run (pose 1 is always 0), not to a crystal.

definitions.name: dock
definitions.signature: structure_ref, ligand, center=None, size=(20, 20, 20), chain=None, exhaustiveness=8, n_poses=5, seed=61453, box_from_ligand=None
definitions.documentation:
Dock a ligand into a fetched structure with AutoDock Vina.

Returns poses (affinity kcal/mol, RMSD lower/upper bound, heavy-atom coords for
the viewer), the box used, timing, and the notes on interpretation.

coverage: Packaged implementation; no direct test reference found.

definitions.name: _fmt
definitions.documentation: Render a cite record's value with a unit, tolerating None values.

definitions.name: compounding_sheet
definitions.documentation: Markdown run sheet from a compound.screen() result.

definitions.name: qc_plan
definitions.documentation: Markdown incoming + release QC plan with ASTM/ISO methods and action limits.

definitions.name: _get_json
definitions.documentation: GET a JSON endpoint with urllib and return the parsed object.

definitions.name: _get_text
definitions.documentation: GET a plain-text endpoint (a CIF) and return its text.

definitions.name: _hill_formula
definitions.documentation: Best-effort Hill-notation formula (space separated) for a COD formula query.

definitions.name: search
definitions.documentation:
Search the COD for crystal structures.

``formula`` is converted to Hill notation; ``elements`` (a list of symbols) maps to
the COD ``el1..el8`` parameters; ``text`` searches entry metadata. Returns a list of
candidate dicts (COD id, formula, space group, cell, year, journal, DOI, URL). Cell
numbers are ``cited`` to the exact search URL; the rest are strings.

definitions.name: _download_cif
definitions.documentation:
Return (cif_text, source_url, from_cache) for a COD id.

Caches the downloaded CIF under the runtime data directory. ``offline=True``
returns the cached CIF or raises a clear error.

definitions.name: _cif_metadata
definitions.documentation: Extract bibliographic strings from the CIF via pymatgen's CifFile parser.

definitions.name: _structure_from_text
definitions.documentation: Parse a CIF with pymatgen; returns (structure, partial_occupancy_flag).

definitions.name: _quiet
definitions.documentation: Run a function with library warnings suppressed (spglib/CrystalNN chatter).

definitions.name: _analyze
definitions.documentation: Assemble the structure card from a parsed pymatgen Structure.

definitions.name: fetch
definitions.documentation:
Download and analyse one COD structure.

Returns the structure card (formula, space group, lattice, volume, Z, density,
atoms for the viewer, coordination summary, reference). Lattice numbers are
``cited`` to the COD CIF URL with ``verified=True`` on a fresh fetch and
``verified=False`` when served from the local cache. Never raises.

definitions.name: xrd_pattern
definitions.documentation:
Powder XRD peaks for a pymatgen Structure (intensity >= 1 % of max).

Returns ``{peaks, wavelength, two_theta_range}``; each peak carries 2θ, d-spacing,
hkl and relative intensity. Used by ``xrd`` (COD path) and directly by the tests.

definitions.name: xrd
definitions.documentation:
Simulated powder XRD pattern (Cu Kα by default) for a COD structure.

Returns peaks with intensity >= 1 % of the maximum, each with 2θ, d-spacing, hkl
and relative intensity, computed by pymatgen's XRDCalculator (kinematic model,
no peak broadening, no absorption). ``wavelength`` is a pymatgen XRDCalculator key
('CuKa' = 1.5406 Å, 'MoKa', 'CoKa', 'FeKa', ...).

definitions.name: supercell
definitions.documentation: Repeat a COD cell n×n×n for the viewer (n capped at MAX_SUPERCELL).

definitions.name: density_from_cell
definitions.documentation:
Density (g/cm³) of a cell from a list of element symbols and its volume (Å³).

Uses CIAAW/IUPAC atomic masses (pymatgen ``Element.atomic_mass``) and the CODATA
Avogadro constant: rho = sum(masses) / (N_A · V).

definitions.name: from_formula_prototype
definitions.documentation:
Build an idealised prototype structure with ASE.

``prototype`` in rocksalt | fcc | bcc | hcp | diamond | perovskite. ``a`` is the
cubic lattice parameter in Å (hcp uses it for a, c = sqrt(8/3)·a). The result is
clearly labelled an idealised prototype (``kind='user'`` for ``a``), not an
experimental determination.

coverage: Packaged implementation; no direct test reference found.

definitions.name: _tdb_files
definitions.documentation: List (name, tdb_path, meta) for every shipped database, sorted by name.

definitions.name: systems
definitions.documentation: List the shipped thermodynamic databases (no computation).

definitions.name: _load_database
definitions.documentation: Return (pycalphad Database, meta) for a shipped database name.

definitions.name: _stable_phases
definitions.documentation:
List of (phase_name, amount, x_second) for phases above the threshold.

``second`` names the component whose mole fraction is reported (defaults to the
last non-reference component, i.e. the second of a binary pair).

definitions.name: equilibrium_point
definitions.documentation:
Stable phases, amounts and compositions at one (T, P, x) point.

``conditions`` = ``{'T': K, 'P': Pa, 'x': mole fraction of comps[1]}``. Returns the
phase list plus the overall conditions. The caller must provide exactly two elements.

definitions.name: _grid
definitions.signature: dbf, comps, phases, Ts, Xs, P
definitions.documentation:
Compute the stable phase-set at every (T, X) grid point plus tie-lines.

Returns (rows, tie_lines) where rows[i][j] is a frozenset of stable phase names and
tie_lines collects one tie-line per two-phase region per temperature row.

definitions.name: _boundaries
definitions.documentation:
Extract phase-region boundary polylines from a categorical phase-set grid.

Boundary points are placed at the midpoint of every grid edge whose two endpoints
differ, then chained greedily by proximity (in normalized X-T space) into polylines.

definitions.name: _chain
definitions.documentation: Greedily chain nearby points into polylines in normalized (X, T) space.

definitions.name: binary_phase_diagram
definitions.signature: tdb, comps, T_range=None, x_range=None, P=101325.0, nT=None, nx=None

coverage: Packaged implementation; no direct test reference found.

definitions.name: _codata
definitions.documentation: CODATA 2018 constant read from the NIST table during this build.

definitions.name: _pmg
definitions.documentation: A value read from pymatgen's bundled periodic-table data (not re-fetched).

definitions.name: element
definitions.documentation:
Periodic-table card for one element from pymatgen ``Element``.

Returns the named properties as cite records, plus a ``notes`` list. ``density``
and ``crystal_structure`` are not present in pymatgen's element table and are
reported as ``null`` with an explanatory note (flagged missing, not invented).

definitions.name: _load_ionic_radii
definitions.documentation:
Load pymatgen's Shannon ionic-radii table once (element -> oxidation -> CN -> Å).

The table stores Shannon *crystal* radii (r(O2-, CN 6) = 1.26 Å convention).

definitions.name: _shannon_radius
definitions.signature: symbol: str, oxidation: int, cn: int
definitions.documentation: (radius_Å, actual_CN) for element at oxidation state, nearest available CN.

definitions.name: ionic_radius_ratio
definitions.signature: cation: str, anion: str, CN: int=6
definitions.documentation:
Cation/anion Shannon radius ratio and the Pauling coordination-number prediction.

Radii are Shannon crystal radii from pymatgen's ``ionic_radii.json`` at the requested
coordination number (nearest tabulated CN when the exact one is absent). The cation
uses its highest common oxidation state, the anion its lowest, which is the usual
ionic-ratio convention and is noted in the result.

definitions.name: _pauling_cn
definitions.documentation:
Pauling coordination prediction from r(cation)/r(anion).

Thresholds are exact from cation/anion contact geometry:
CN 2 < 0.155, CN 3 0.155-0.225, CN 4 0.225-0.414, CN 6 0.414-0.732,
CN 8 0.732-1.0, CN 12 > 1.0.

definitions.name: rule_of_mixtures
definitions.documentation:
Voigt / Reuss / Hashin-Shtrikman bounds on the effective elastic moduli.

``props`` maps two phase names to ``{'K': bulk GPa, 'G': shear GPa, 'E': Young GPa}``
(K and G required; E optional). ``fractions`` are the two volume fractions (sum 1).
``bound`` selects the headline bound: 'voigt', 'reuss', or 'hashin_shtrikman'.

Returns every bound as cite records so the caller (and the ordering test) can
compare them. Hashin-Shtrikman assumes isotropic phases ordered K2>=K1, G2>=G1
(phase 2 stiffer); if the caller's phases are not ordered the phases are swapped
internally and noted.

definitions.name: thermal_expansion_mismatch
definitions.documentation:
Biaxial residual stress from a thermal expansion mismatch.

Film-on-thick-substrate model: sigma = E * (alpha1 - alpha2) * dT / (1 - nu).
``alpha`` in 1e-6/K (ppm/K), ``dT`` in K (cooling = negative), ``E`` in GPa,
``nu`` dimensionless; result in MPa (E[GPa] * dalpha[1e-6/K] * dT[K] / (1-nu)
gives kPa, so the MPa result carries a 1e-3 factor).

definitions.name: hall_petch
definitions.documentation:
Yield strength from the Hall-Petch relation: sigma_y = sigma0 + k / sqrt(d).

``sigma0`` (MPa, friction stress), ``k`` (MPa·sqrt(m), locking parameter),
``d`` (m, grain size). Result in MPa. Empirical; validity ends at very small
grain sizes (inverse Hall-Petch) which is noted but not modelled.

definitions.name: band_gap_brus
definitions.documentation:
Quantum-dot optical gap from the Brus effective-mass equation.

E(R) = E_g + (hbar^2 pi^2 / (2 R^2 m0)) (1/me + 1/mh) - (1.786 e / (4 pi eps0 eps_r R)),
with effective masses in units of the electron mass, R the dot radius, eps_r the
semiconductor relative permittivity. As R -> infinity the corrections vanish and
E -> bulk gap (tested). Effective-mass approximation: valid for radii larger than
a few lattice constants; the confined exciton Coulomb term uses the classical
1.786 prefactor.

coverage: Packaged implementation; no direct test reference found.

definitions.name: _write_filtered_pdb
definitions.documentation:
Write a PDB holding only the selected polymer chains (first model).

Returns (removed_waters, removed_ligands).

definitions.name: gemmi_structure_clone_with_chains
definitions.documentation: Clone the first model, keeping only polymer residues of the named chains.

definitions.name: _selected_chain_names
definitions.documentation: Chain names to keep: the requested one, or every chain with polymer residues.

definitions.name: _chain_gaps
definitions.documentation: Report residue-number jumps (missing residues) we will NOT model.

definitions.name: _input_ca_positions
definitions.documentation: C-alpha positions from the input structure, keyed by (chain, resi).

definitions.name: _simulation_ca_positions
definitions.documentation: C-alpha positions from the simulation, keyed by (chain, resi).

definitions.name: _ca_rmsd
definitions.documentation: RMSD over the C-alpha positions common to both dicts (Å).

definitions.name: _ca_trace
definitions.documentation: C-alpha trace (Å) from the current simulation state, for the viewer.

definitions.name: minimize
definitions.signature: structure_ref, chain=None, steps=500, md_ps=0.0, temperature_K=300, implicit_solvent=True, max_atoms=15000
definitions.documentation:
Minimize (and optionally run short MD on) a fetched structure.

Returns energies (kJ/mol), C-alpha RMSD, platform and wall time; the minimized
C-alpha trace updates the viewer. Refuses atom counts above ``max_atoms`` or
``md_ps`` above 100 ps with a clear error message.

definitions.name: _number
definitions.documentation: Coerce a JSON scalar to a finite float, or raise MechError (never a bare ValueError).

definitions.name: _add_levels
definitions.documentation: Total level of incoherent sources: L_total = 10 log10(sum 10^(L_i/10)) dB.

definitions.name: _total_absorption
definitions.documentation: Total absorption A = sum(alpha_i S_i) and the mean absorption coefficient of the room surfaces.

definitions.name: _a_weighting
definitions.documentation: A-weighting A(f) in dB from the IEC 61672 analytic transfer function (rounded poles).

definitions.name: _noise_dose
definitions.documentation:
OSHA or NIOSH/ISO noise-exposure dose and time-weighted average.

Reference duration for a level L: T = 8 h / 2^((L - criterion)/exchange_rate). Dose = 100 sum(C/T).
TWA = criterion + exchange_rate * log2(dose/100). OSHA: 5 dB exchange, 90 dBA criterion;
NIOSH/ISO: 3 dB exchange, 85 dBA criterion. Every entered level is counted (no threshold is applied).

definitions.name: _atmosphere
definitions.documentation:
ISA / US Standard Atmosphere 1976 temperature, pressure, density and sound speed vs altitude.

The input is GEOMETRIC altitude z; it is converted to geopotential altitude H = r0·z/(r0 + z) (the
US 1976 independent variable) before the layer equations are applied.

definitions.name: _top_speed
definitions.documentation:
Top speed: largest speed where the best tractive force (over all gears whose engine speed is inside
the torque curve) meets the road load, or the top-gear redline speed if force still exceeds it there.

At each speed only gears with w_min <= v·i/r_w <= w_max contribute; the best gear is the one giving the
largest tractive force. Below the first gear's idle speed no gear can pull (clutch-slip region), so the
crossing is sought above that speed. The top speed is the first speed where the best force falls below
road load; if the force is still above road load at the top-gear redline, the top speed is redline-limited.

definitions.name: _top_speed_chart
definitions.documentation: Power available vs power required in the gear that actually reaches the top speed.

definitions.name: _mac
definitions.documentation: Singularity (Macaulay) function <x-a>^n for n >= 0 (scalar).

definitions.name: _mac_v
definitions.documentation: Vectorised singularity function over a numpy array xs.

definitions.name: _parse_loads
_solve_beam
definitions.signature: E, I, L, point_loads, point_moms, dist, simple, fixed
definitions.documentation:
Solve reactions and integration constants for the prismatic beam (Euler–Bernoulli).

Unknowns: one vertical reaction per support (simple then fixed order), one CCW moment reaction per
fixed support, and the two integration constants C3 = EI·θ(0), C4 = EI·v(0). Equations: overall
ΣFy = 0, ΣM = 0, v = 0 at simple supports, and v = 0 plus θ = 0 at fixed supports.

definitions.name: _fields
definitions.signature: xs, R, supp_pts, Mf, fixed, C3, C4, EI, point_loads, point_moms, dist
definitions.documentation: Vectorised V, M, θ, v on the grid xs (θ and v already divided by EI).

definitions.name: _max_abs
definitions.documentation:
Location and magnitude of the maximum |field| (a vectorised function of x).

The field is piecewise-smooth with step jumps at ``jumps`` (concentrated moments and fixed-support
reaction moments). A dense grid plus golden-section refinement finds interior smooth maxima; each
jump is additionally probed on both sides (d ± eps) so a peak that sits exactly at a discontinuity —
e.g. the fixed-end moment of a cantilever at x = L — is reported at its true magnitude instead of
collapsing to the post-jump value (zero just outside a right-end support).

definitions.name: _general_beam
definitions.documentation: General prismatic Euler–Bernoulli beam: reactions, SFD/BMD/slope/deflection and their extrema.

definitions.name: _sfd_bmd_chart
definitions.documentation: Chart specs for the shear-force and bending-moment diagrams.

definitions.name: _ss_point_offcenter
definitions.documentation:
Simply supported beam with an off-centre point load: reactions, max moment and load-point
deflection, checked against the geometry relation L = a + b.

definitions.name: _bearing_life
definitions.documentation:
Rating life L10 (millions of rev) and L10h (hours) from C, equivalent load P, exponent a, speed n.

L10 = (C/P)^a with a = 3 (ball) or 10/3 (roller). L10h = L10 * 1e6 / (3600 * n) with n in rev/s (Hz).

definitions.name: _weibull
definitions.documentation:
Reliability R from the three-parameter Weibull bearing-life distribution.

R = exp(-((L - x0)/(theta - x0))^b). Requires theta > x0 (characteristic life above the guaranteed
life) and L >= x0 (life of interest at least the guaranteed life), and b > 0; raises MechError
otherwise, because the ratio (L - x0)/(theta - x0) must be a real fraction in [0, 1].

imports: from engineering_sim.science.mech.core import Calc, MechError, V, section
coverage: Packaged implementation; no direct test reference found.

definitions.name: _chain_length
definitions.documentation:
Roller-chain length from center distance C_p (pitches), pitch p, sprocket teeth N1, N2.

L_p = 2 C_p + (N1 + N2)/2 + (N2 - N1)^2 / (4 pi^2 C_p)   (pitches)
Number of links is rounded up to the nearest EVEN integer; chain length L = L_p p.

definitions.name: _belt_length
definitions.documentation:
Exact open-belt length (no small-angle approximation), D2 >= D1.

alpha = asin((D2 - D1)/(2C)); wrap theta_s = pi - 2 alpha (small), theta_l = pi + 2 alpha (large).
L = sqrt(4 C^2 - (D2 - D1)^2) + (D2 theta_l + D1 theta_s)/2.

definitions.name: _belt_tension_ratio
definitions.documentation:
Total tight-side tension from the capstan relation with centrifugal tension.

(T1 - T_c) = (T2 - T_c) e^(mu theta); the slack-side effective tension must be positive.

imports: from engineering_sim.science.mech.core import Calc, MechError, V, section
coverage: Packaged implementation; no direct test reference found.

definitions.name: _frustum
definitions.documentation:
Member stiffness of a joint with two equal clamped members (equal-member two-frustum form).

One frustum grows from the head and one from the nut, each of length L/2, in series (hence the
factor 2 in the denominator):

k_m = π E d tanα / (2 ln[ ((L tanα + D − d)(D + d)) / ((L tanα + D + d)(D − d)) ])

with D the washer/head face diameter, α the cone half-apex angle (≈30°), d the bolt diameter and
L the total grip length.

definitions.name: _bolt_fatigue
definitions.documentation:
Bolt fatigue by the constant-preload Goodman line, plus the separation factor of safety.

The bolt stress oscillates between σi = F_i/A_t and σi + C·Pmax/A_t, so the alternating stress is
σa = C(Pmax − Pmin)/(2 A_t) and the midrange stress is σm = C(Pmax + Pmin)/(2 A_t) + σi. With the
Goodman line drawn from the preload (the preload is always present), the factor of safety is
n_f = Se(Sut − σi) / (Sut σa + Se(σm − σi)).

definitions.name: _load_sharing
definitions.documentation:
External-load sharing, separation load and a separation warning for a preloaded joint.

C = k_b/(k_b + k_m); the bolt carries F_i + C P and the member F_i − (1−C) P. When P exceeds
P_sep = F_i/(1−C) the member load reaches zero — the joint separates and the bolt carries the
full external load — which is surfaced as a warning.

definitions.name: _bolt_group
definitions.documentation:
Elastic (torsion) analysis of a bolt group under an eccentric shear load.

Direct shear is shared equally; the moment M about the bolt centroid is resisted by shear
proportional to each bolt's distance from the centroid (elastic method, no instantaneous-centre
iteration). Returns per-bolt resultants and the largest one.

definitions.signature: title, xlabel, ylabel, series_list, markers=None, equal=False, xlog=False, ylog=False, hlines=None, vlines=None

definitions.name: circle
definitions.documentation: Closed polyline approximating a circle (Mohr's circle, bolt circles).

coverage: Packaged implementation; no direct test reference found.

definitions.name: _drum_short
definitions.documentation:
Single internal-expanding short shoe (point-force model).

sense 'leading' is self-energizing (F = N(a - mu b)/c); 'trailing' adds the friction moment.
T = mu N r. a, b, c are perpendicular lever arms from the pivot to the lines of action of N, fN
and F respectively (see module docstring).

definitions.name: _drum_long
definitions.documentation:
Single internal-expanding long shoe with sinusoidal pressure p = p_a sin(theta)/sin(theta_a).

The angle of maximum pressure is theta_a = min(theta2, 90 deg): the pressure peaks at the heel when
the shoe does not wrap past 90 deg, otherwise at 90 deg (so it must also satisfy theta1 <= theta_a).
Standard internal-shoe integrals (Shigley): moment of normal forces M_N, of friction M_f about the
hinge pin, braking torque T about the drum centre, and actuating force F = (M_N - M_f)/c for a
self-energizing (leading) shoe or (M_N + M_f)/c for a trailing shoe. A leading shoe self-locks when
M_N - M_f <= 0.

definitions.name: _turning_moment
definitions.documentation:
Flywheel energy fluctuation from a turning-moment diagram.

torque_curve: [[angle (deg), torque (N·m)], ...] over one full cycle with strictly increasing
angles. The mean torque is the trapezoidal average; the cumulative energy W(theta) = integral of
(T - T_mean) d(theta) gives the fluctuation delta_E = W_max - W_min (largest excess of energy,
which the flywheel must store and return).

imports: from engineering_sim.science.mech.core import Calc, MechError, V, section
coverage: Packaged implementation; no direct test reference found.

definitions.name: _column_critical
definitions.documentation:
Critical load/stress of a concentrically loaded column, Euler or Johnson by slenderness.

Returns radius of gyration r, slenderness λ = KL/r, the Euler–Johnson transition slenderness
λ_t = π·sqrt(2E/Sy), the critical stress σ_cr (Johnson below λ_t, Euler at/above) and P_cr = σ_cr·A.

definitions.name: _secant_column
definitions.documentation:
Maximum compressive stress of an eccentrically loaded column (secant formula).

σ_max = (P/A)[1 + (ec/r²)sec(arg)] with arg = KL/(2r)·√(P/(EA)). Requires arg < π/2: beyond it
the column is past its first instability and the formula is not physical (this also keeps the
numeric inversion unique, since σ_max is monotonic in every input over the physical range).

definitions.name: _atoms
definitions.documentation: Atom counts {C, H, O} parsed from a molecular formula over C/H/O only (e.g. 'C2H6O').

definitions.name: _a_o2
definitions.documentation: Moles of O2 needed to burn one mole of CxHyOz to CO2 and H2O.

definitions.name: _stoichiometric_air
definitions.documentation:
Stoichiometric oxygen and air requirements for a CxHyOz fuel (per kmol fuel).

CxHyOz + a(O2 + 3.76 N2) -> x CO2 + (y/2) H2O + 3.76 a N2, with a = x + y/4 − z/2. Air-fuel ratio on a
mass basis uses MW_air = 28.97 kg/kmol.

definitions.name: _products
definitions.documentation:
Products of combustion of CxHyOz with an excess-air ratio λ, plus the water dew point.

Products per kmol fuel: x CO2, (y/2) H2O, (λ−1)a O2, 3.76 λ a N2. The water partial pressure
P_H2O = y_H2O · P_total gives the dew point through the Water saturation curve (CoolProp/IAPWS-95).

definitions.name: _heating_values_formation
definitions.documentation:
Heating values from formation enthalpies (per mole of CxHyOz fuel).

ΔH_comb = [x hf(CO2) + (y/2) hf(H2O)] − [hf(fuel) + a hf(O2)] with hf(O2) = 0. The LHV uses gaseous
product water, the HHV liquid product water; both are −ΔH_comb. Mass-basis values divide by the molar
mass (MW in kg/kmol, so kg/mol = MW/1000).

definitions.name: _heating_value_fuel
definitions.documentation:
Heating values of a named fuel via the NIST-WebBook Shomate engine (engineering_sim.science.thermo).

The balanced combustion reaction (fuel + a O2 -> C CO2 + (H/2) H2O) is assembled from the formula and
its ΔH read from ``thermo.reaction``; LHV uses H2O(g), HHV uses H2O(l). Values are per mole of fuel.

definitions.name: _reaction_thermo
definitions.documentation:
Enthalpy/entropy/Gibbs change and equilibrium constant of a reaction via thermo.reaction.

reactants/products are {species_key: coefficient} dicts (e.g. {'H2': 1, 'O2': 0.5} -> {'H2O(g)': 1}).
Returns dH, dG in J/mol, dS in J/(mol·K) and the equilibrium constant K = exp(−dG/RT), all per mole of
reaction as written.

definitions.name: _equilibrium_constant
definitions.documentation:
Equilibrium constant from a standard Gibbs-energy change, K = exp(−ΔG/RT).

Returns K, ln K and log10 K. K itself is None when exp(ln K) overflows double precision, with a
``_warnings`` note pointing the caller at the log forms.

definitions.name: _chemical_equilibrium
definitions.documentation:
Cantera equilibrium via common.equilibrium.

constraint 'TP' returns the equilibrium composition at (T, P); 'HP' returns the adiabatic flame
temperature and composition (reactant T and P fixed); 'UV' the constant-volume explosion temperature.
Returns the equilibrium temperature T_out (K), density (kg/m³) and the major species mole fractions
(most abundant first, X ≥ 1e-6).

imports: from engineering_sim.science.mech.core import Calc, MechError, V, section
coverage: Test-text reference only; not measured branch/function coverage.

definitions.name: fluid_state
definitions.documentation:
State of a CoolProp fluid from exactly two of T (K), P (Pa), Q (0..1), h (J/kg), s (J/kg/K), rho.

Returns {'T','P','rho','h','s','cp','cv','mu','k','phase','quality'} in SI. Transport properties are
None when CoolProp has no model for the fluid/phase (e.g. inside the two-phase dome).

definitions.name: saturation
definitions.documentation: Saturation point by T (K) or P (Pa): {'T','P','liquid': {...}, 'vapour': {...}} in SI.

definitions.name: humid_air
definitions.documentation:
Moist-air property via CoolProp HAPropsSI (SI names: T, B wet bulb, D dew point, R relative humidity
0..1, W humidity ratio kg/kg, H enthalpy J/kg dry air, V m³/kg dry air, P total pressure Pa).

Exactly three inputs, one of which must be P. Real-gas ASHRAE RP-1485 model (not ideal-gas psychrometrics).

definitions.name: lmtd
definitions.documentation: Log-mean temperature difference (K) — delegates to chemeng_balance.lmtd.

definitions.name: hall_petch
definitions.documentation: Hall–Petch yield strength in Pa — delegates to materials_props.hall_petch (which works in MPa).

definitions.name: elastic_bounds
definitions.documentation:
Two-phase effective-modulus bounds in Pa — delegates to materials_props.rule_of_mixtures (GPa API).

Returns {'voigt': {'K','G'}, 'reuss': {...}, 'hs_upper': {...}, 'hs_lower': {...}}. Phase 1 volume
fraction f1; isotropic phases. The fibre-composite relations E1 = Vf·Ef + Vm·Em and
1/E2 = Vf/Ef + Vm/Em are simple section equations, not a duplicate of this bound calculation.

definitions.name: equilibrium
definitions.documentation:
Cantera chemical equilibrium — delegates to chemeng_kinetics.equilibrate (P converted Pa→bar).

mixture is {species: moles}, e.g. {'CH4': 1, 'O2': 2, 'N2': 7.52}. constraint 'HP' from the reactant
temperature gives the adiabatic flame temperature (key 'T', K). Returns the wrapped
result with its records unwrapped where they are plain values.

definitions.name: g0
definitions.documentation: Standard gravity 9.80665 m/s² (exact by definition, CGPM 1901).

definitions.name: finite
definitions.documentation: Raise MechError unless x is a finite float (use in procedures before returning).

coverage: Test-text reference only; not measured branch/function coverage.

definitions.name: _area_ratio
definitions.documentation: Isentropic A/A* at Mach M (>= 0). Returns inf when M -> 0.

definitions.name: _theta_from_beta
definitions.documentation: Oblique-shock deflection angle theta (rad) for upstream Mach M, shock angle beta.

definitions.name: _area_mach
definitions.documentation: Mach numbers whose A/A* equals A_Astar: (M_sub < 1, M_super > 1). Requires A_Astar >= 1.

definitions.name: _beta_weak_strong
definitions.documentation: Oblique-shock angles beta (weak, strong) for upstream Mach M, deflection theta (rad).

definitions.name: _shock_ratios
definitions.documentation: Normal-shock property ratios across M1n (normal component): (M2n, P2/P1, rho2/rho1, T2/T1).

definitions.name: _area_ratio_inverse
definitions.documentation: Inverse area-Mach: both Mach numbers whose isentropic A/A* equals the given value.

definitions.name: _oblique_shock
definitions.documentation: Oblique shock from (M, theta, gamma): weak and strong shock angles plus downstream properties.

definitions.name: _area_ratio_chart
definitions.documentation: A/A* vs M on log-log axes for the given gamma (M from 0.1 to 10).

definitions.name: _theta_beta_m_chart
definitions.documentation: theta-beta-M curve for the given upstream M and gamma.
