definitions.name: viscosity_iv_exponent
definitions.documentation: η0 ∝ Mw^3.4 and [η] ∝ M^a at constant PDI give η0 ∝ IV^(3.4/a).

definitions.name: chain_ends_mmol_kg
definitions.documentation: Linear chains carry two ends: 2/Mn mol/g.

definitions.name: hydrolysis
definitions.documentation: One scission, one new COOH and one new OH per reacted water. 1/Mn = 1/Mn0 + w/M_water.

definitions.name: epoxy_mmol_kg
definitions.documentation: Epoxy groups per kg compound for a loading in wt%.

definitions.name: cooh_end_fraction
definitions.documentation: Fraction p of chain ends that are carboxyl (the rest hydroxyl), bounded to [0, 1].

definitions.name: gel_critical_conversion
definitions.documentation:
Mean-field (Macosko–Miller) gel point for an A_f epoxy + PET chains with 0/1/2 COOH ends.

COOH ends distributed binomially over the two chain ends with probability p give a
weight-average COOH functionality f_B,w = 1 + p. Gelation when
    α_A · α_B · (f_A,w − 1) · (f_B,w − 1) = 1,   α_B = r · α_A,   r = epoxy / COOH.
Returns the critical epoxy conversion α_A (None when the system cannot gel before one
reactant is exhausted). Ignores epoxy–OH reaction (which adds gel risk), and
ester interchange and cyclisation (which delay or dissolve a network).

definitions.name: gel_benchmark_a3_b2
definitions.documentation: Flory classic: stoichiometric A3 + B2 gels at α = 1/√2 (f_B,w − 1 = 1 ⇒ p = 1).

definitions.name: max_extender_without_gel
definitions.documentation: Largest loading (wt%) whose critical conversion stays above the expected conversion.

definitions.name: critical_length_mm

definitions.name: length_factor

definitions.signature: wt, sigma_f, d_um, ifss, length_mm, eta_o, sigma_m, rho_f=None, rho_m=None, eta_l=None

definitions.name: iso75_deflection_mm
definitions.documentation: ISO 75-1 standard deflection Δs = ε_f L² / (600 h), ε_f in %.

definitions.name: iso75_modulus_criterion_mpa
definitions.documentation: Elastic estimate of the flexural modulus at which the bar reaches Δs under load.

definitions.name: flory_tm_c

REVISED    the claim used the wrong model; the corrected model changes the conclusion
BOUNDED    only a bound can be computed; the claim needs measurement

With no argument, returns a sorted list of ``{key, name, formula, phase}``

definitions.name: _shomate_range
definitions.documentation:
Pick the Shomate coefficient range for temperature T.

Raises ValueError outside [298.15 K, max T]. Between 298.15 K and the first
range's lower bound the first range is used (the fit is anchored so that
H - H298 == 0 and S == S298 at 298.15 K).

definitions.name: props
definitions.documentation:
Standard-state molar properties of ``key`` at ``T`` as value records.

Returns ``{cp, h, s, g}`` (all ``kind='derived'``, method "Shomate/NIST WebBook"):
cp in J/mol*K, h = dHf298 + (H-H298) in kJ/mol, s in J/mol*K,
g = h - T*s/1000 in kJ/mol. Raises KeyError for an unknown species and
ValueError outside the valid temperature range.

definitions.name: _elements
definitions.documentation: Element composition {El: n} of a species record.

definitions.name: _balance
definitions.documentation:
Return ``(balanced, imbalance)`` for a stoichiometric reaction.

``imbalance`` maps element -> (reactant_atoms - product_atoms). Unknown species
keys raise KeyError (also from the side dicts here).

definitions.name: reaction
definitions.signature: reactants: dict, products: dict, T: float=298.15
definitions.documentation:
Direct reaction ``reactants -> products`` at temperature T.

``reactants`` / ``products`` are ``{species_key: stoichiometric_coefficient}``
(e.g. ``{"H2": 2, "O2": 1} -> {"H2O(g)": 2}``). Element balance is checked and a
ValueError is raised (stating the imbalance) if it fails.

Returns value records: dH (kJ/mol), dS (J/mol*K), dG (kJ/mol),
K = exp(-dG/RT) (dimensionless), ``favored`` (bool, dG < 0), and per-species
``contributions``. All derived by the Shomate/NIST WebBook method.

definitions.name: equilibrium
definitions.signature: feed: dict, candidates: list, T: float, P_bar: float
definitions.documentation:
Gibbs-energy minimisation over ``candidates`` with element conservation.

Parameters
----------
feed : dict
    ``{species_key: moles}`` of the initial material (e.g. ``{"H2": 1.0}``).
candidates : list[str]
    Species keys allowed to form (a subset of the database). Feed keys are
    added automatically if missing, so the initial state is always reachable.
T : float
    Temperature in K (298.15 <= T <= 6000).
P_bar : float
    Total pressure in bar (used only for the gas phase; condensed phases are
    pure with activity 1).

Returns
-------
dict with ``amounts`` (mol per species, trace < 1e-12 clipped to 0),
``gas_mole_fractions`` (gas species with positive amount), ``total_g``
(kJ for the whole system), ``n_gas_total`` (mol), ``converged`` (bool),
``message``, ``T`` and ``P_bar``. Condensed phases are allowed to vanish.

coverage: Test-text reference only; not measured branch/function coverage.

definitions.name: epoxy_amine_phr
definitions.documentation: Parts hardener per 100 parts resin: phr = 100 * AHEW / EEW (both g/eq).

definitions.name: polyol_phr
definitions.documentation:
Parts polyol per 100 parts isocyanate at a given NCO index.

NCO equivalent weight = 4202 / NCO %; OH equivalent weight = 56100 / OH number
(mg KOH/g). phr_polyol = 100 * eq_OH / eq_NCO / NCO_index, so an index above 1
(excess isocyanate) reduces the polyol charge.

definitions.name: flory_stockmayer_gel
definitions.documentation:
Critical conversion of the A groups at the Flory-Stockmayer gel point.

For an A_fa + B_fb step polymerisation at group ratio r = A/B, gelation occurs
when alpha_A * alpha_B * (fa - 1) * (fb - 1) = 1 with alpha_B = r * alpha_A, i.e.
    alpha_A = 1 / sqrt(r * (fa - 1) * (fb - 1)).
Returns None when the system cannot gel before a reactant is exhausted.

definitions.name: dibenedetto_tg
definitions.documentation:
Glass transition vs extent of cure x in [0, 1] by DiBenedetto's equation.

    Tg(x) = lam * x * (Tg_inf - Tg0) / (1 - (1 - lam) * x) + Tg0

Limits: x=0 -> Tg0, x=1 -> Tg_inf. Temperatures in Celsius.

definitions.name: _rec_of
definitions.documentation: Numeric value of a cite-record field, or None when the field is absent/null.

definitions.name: screen
definitions.documentation:
Screen one thermoset system.

system keys:
  system    -- id of a library record in data/thermosets.json (or pass the record
               directly under 'record')
  ratio     -- group ratio A/B override (default: the library stoichiometric ratio)
  conversion, lam, tg0_c  -- optional DiBenedetto inputs (defaults 0.9 / 0.6 / Tg0
                             = the resin's unmixed-glass value, 25 C when unknown)

Returns a dict of cite records: mix ratio (phr), gel conversion, Tg at the chosen
conversion, plus exotherm/pot-life/hazard flags from the library record.

definitions.name: _lookup
definitions.documentation: Load one thermoset record from the data library by id (stdlib json).

coverage: Packaged implementation; no direct test reference found.

definitions.name: vapor_pressure
definitions.documentation:
Saturated vapour pressure of one additive at T_K (Kelvin), as a cite record.

record may carry:
  antoine = {A, B, C, tmin_K, tmax_K, source}  -> log10(P/bar) = A - B/(T + C)
  normal_boiling_point_K + dhvap_kj_mol        -> Clausius-Clapeyron from P0 = 1 atm
  (dhvap_kj_mol omitted -> estimated by Trouton's rule from the boiling point)

Returns cite.value(p_bar, 'bar', 'estimated', method=..., source=...).
Raises ValueError when an Antoine temperature is outside its stated range.

definitions.name: _bp_k_from_record
definitions.documentation: Normal boiling point in Kelvin from a library record's boiling_point_c cite field.

definitions.name: loss_fraction
definitions.signature: k_m_s, resin_mn_g_mol, p_sat_bar, specific_surface_m2_kg, residence_s, T_K
definitions.documentation:
Evaporation-limited upper-bound mass fraction of one additive lost through the vent.

Model and assumptions (see screen()): the additive is a dilute ideal solution in
the resin (Raoult), the vent sweeps the gas phase so the bulk additive partial
pressure is ~0, and the only resistance is the gas-side film (coefficient k_m).
In that limit the additive's own loading and molar mass cancel and

    f = k_m * M_resin * P_sat * (A/m_melt) * t / (R * T)

with M_resin in kg/mol, P_sat in Pa. The result is an upper bound: a partially
loaded vent or a thicker film raises the resistance and lowers the loss.

definitions.name: screen
definitions.documentation:
Estimate additive vent loss and volatility flags for one compounding run.

args keys (all optional except melt_temp_c, residence_s, vent_pressure_mbar,
additives):
  melt_temp_c, residence_s, vent_pressure_mbar  -- process
  resin_mn_g_mol (default 20000)                -- melt Mn for the Raoult dilution
  surface_area_m2 (default 0.005), melt_mass_kg (default 1.0)  -- vent geometry
  film_mass_transfer_m_s (default 0.01)         -- gas-side film coefficient
  additives -- list of library records (each may carry boiling_point_c, antoine,
               tga_1pct_loss_c, tga_5pct_loss_c, flash_point_c)

Returns a dict: 'model' (assumption text), 'sensitivity' (loss range at the
low/high film coefficients), and 'additives' with one entry per additive giving
vapour pressure, estimated loss fraction and the flash/TGA flags.

coverage: Packaged implementation; no direct test reference found.

definitions.name: _run
definitions.documentation: Resolve the op name to a handler; unknown ops fail before any import.

coverage: Test-text reference only; not measured branch/function coverage.

definitions.name: _make_calculator
definitions.documentation: Build a silent GFN2-xTB calculator for the given structure.

definitions.name: _initial_geometry
definitions.documentation:
Deterministic 3D starting geometry for an RDKit molecule (Angstrom).

Uses ETKDG embedding with a fixed seed; falls back to atoms laid out along z
(a robust start for single atoms, diatomics and radical fragments that ETKDG
cannot embed).

definitions.name: _homo_lumo_gap
definitions.documentation: HOMO-LUMO gap in eV, or None when the result has no virtual orbitals.

definitions.name: _atom_energy
definitions.documentation: GFN2-xTB electronic energy of an isolated atom (Hartree).

definitions.name: estimate
definitions.documentation:
Run a GFN2-xTB geometry optimisation and return estimated properties.

Parameters
----------
smiles : str
    SMILES of the species (radicals kept explicit; ``[H][H]`` is H2).

Returns
-------
dict with canonical SMILES, formula, charge, multiplicity, unpaired electron
count (``uhf``), electronic energy (Hartree), optimised coordinates (Angstrom),
HOMO-LUMO gap (eV), dipole (Debye), atomization energy (kJ/mol), and
convergence info. All numbers are ``kind='estimated'`` GFN2-xTB records.

coverage: Packaged implementation; no direct test reference found.

definitions.name: tube_area_moment
definitions.documentation:
Second moment of area of a hollow circular section (m^4).

I = pi (D^4 - d^4) / 64. D = outer diameter, d = inner diameter (m).

definitions.name: tube_polar_moment
definitions.documentation:
Polar (torsion) second moment of area of a hollow circular section (m^4).

J = pi (D^4 - d^4) / 32 = 2 * I.

definitions.name: rect_area_moment
definitions.documentation:
Second moment of area of a solid rectangle about its neutral axis (m^4).

I = w h^3 / 12.

definitions.name: rect_tube_area_moment
definitions.documentation:
Second moment of area of a thin-walled rectangular tube (m^4).

I = (w h^3 - (w - 2t)(h - 2t)^3) / 12, outer w x h, wall t.

definitions.name: bredt_batho_J
definitions.documentation:
Bredt-Batho torsion constant of a thin-walled closed section (m^4).

J = 4 A_m^2 t / perimeter, where A_m is the area enclosed by the wall mid-line and
perimeter the mid-line perimeter (circumferential length), t the (uniform) wall
thickness. Cited: Megson, "Aircraft Structures for Engineering Students" (Bredt-Batho
formula for a thin-walled single closed cell). For a circular tube of mean radius r
this reduces to 2 pi r^3 t; for a rectangular tube it is exact for a uniform-thickness
box section.

definitions.name: thin_tube_polar_moment
definitions.documentation:
Torsion constant of a thin circular tube, J = 2 pi r^3 t (m^4).

r is the mean radius (mid-wall), t the wall thickness; thin-wall limit of
``tube_polar_moment(2r+t, 2r-t)``. Independent analytic result used by the tests.

definitions.name: rect_tube_polar_moment
definitions.documentation:
Bredt-Batho torsion constant of a thin-walled rectangular box section (m^4).

A_m = (w - t)(h - t) (mid-line enclosure), perimeter = 2[(w - t) + (h - t)], so
J = 4 A_m^2 t / perimeter. w, h are the outer dimensions, t the wall.

definitions.name: polygon_area_perimeter
definitions.documentation:
Shoelace area and perimeter of a 2-D polygon (pts: Nx2 array), area in |units|^2.

Assumes an ordered (simple, closed) polygon; the returned area is signed (positive
for counter-clockwise) and the perimeter is the closed-loop length.

definitions.name: offset_polygon_inward
definitions.documentation:
Offset a counter-clockwise simple polygon inward by distance ``d`` (m).

Each edge is shifted along its inward (left) normal by ``d`` and consecutive shifted
edges are intersected to form the offset vertices — the exact straight-edge polygon
offset. Returns the offset polygon (same orientation); used to place the wall
mid-line at t/2 inside the printed outer skin for the Bredt-Batho section.

definitions.name: airfoil_shell_geometry
definitions.documentation:
Closed-section mid-line geometry of a printed wing skin (m, m).

``coords`` is the baseline airfoil (x/c, z/c) as a TE -> upper -> LE -> lower -> TE
loop. It is scaled by ``chord_m``; the part aft of ``x_start_frac`` (a morph-zone
hinge, which is an open section and carries no torsion) is cut off and closed with a
straight edge at the hinge. The polygon is then offset inward by t/2 (the wall
mid-line) and its enclosed area A_m and perimeter are returned (with the shoelace
area before offset for reference). Returns dict(Am, perimeter, area_outer, chord_m).

definitions.name: _interp_z
definitions.documentation: Linearly interpolate z at x=xh on an x-ordered upper/lower surface point list.

definitions.name: schrenk_semi_span_load
definitions.documentation:
Semi-span lift per unit span by the Schrenk approximation (N/m).

The lift distribution is the average of the elliptic (ideal) distribution and the
planform (chord-proportional) distribution, each normalised to the same semi-span
total n*W/2:

    L'_ell(y)     = (4 n W / (pi b)) * sqrt(1 - (2y/b)^2)
    L'_plan(y)    = (n W / S) * c(y)
    L'(y)         = 0.5 * (L'_ell + L'_plan)

so that int_0^{b/2} L'(y) dy = n W / 2 (the elliptic peak 4 n W/(pi b) gives a
semi-span integral of n W/2, and the planform term integrates to n W/2 exactly).
c(y) is a linear taper between root_chord_m and tip_chord_m (or a station table
if ``wing["stations"]`` is given). Returns ``(y, load)`` arrays (metres, N/m).

definitions.name: shear_moment_from_load
definitions.documentation:
Integrate semi-span lift to shear force and bending moment (root -> tip).

With y from root (0) to tip (b/2), the shear at station y is the load outboard of y
and the moment is that load times its lever arm:

    V(y) = int_y^{tip} L'(eta) d eta
    M(y) = int_y^{tip} L'(eta) (eta - y) d eta

Trapezoidal integration on the supplied grid. Returns (V, M) arrays (N, N m).

definitions.name: cantilever_deflection
definitions.documentation:
Tip deflection of a cantilever from the bending-moment curve (double integration).

With the root at y=0 clamped (zero slope and deflection at the root) and M(y) the
bending moment, the curvature is M/EI, and

    deflection(y) = int_0^y int_0^{s} M(t)/EI dt ds

EI may be a scalar or an array along y. Trapezoidal integration. Returns the full
deflection array; the tip value is ``deflection[-1]``.

definitions.name: tip_deflection_uniform
definitions.documentation:
Closed-form cantilever tip deflection under uniform load w: w L^4 / (8 EI).

Independent analytic result used by the tests to validate :func:`cantilever_deflection`.

definitions.name: flap_coefficients
definitions.documentation:
Thin-airfoil (Glauert / Abbott & von Doenhoff) coefficients for a plain flap
hinged at x_start (fraction of chord from the leading edge).

With theta from the leading edge, x/c = (1 - cos theta)/2, the flap occupies
theta in [theta_h, pi] where theta_h = arccos(1 - 2 x_start). A flap deflection
delta changes the camber slope by -delta over the flap; the bound vorticity is

    gamma(theta) = 2 U [ A0 (1 + cos theta)/sin theta + sum_n A_n sin(n theta) ],
    A0 = alpha + delta (pi - theta_h)/pi,  A_n = 2 delta sin(n theta_h)/(n pi).

Lift:  C_L = 2 pi A0 + pi A_1, giving  dC_L/d_delta = 2 (pi - theta_h + sin theta_h)
(analytic). The hinge moment about x_start and the pitching moment about x_ac are
integrated from the same loading; the hinge-moment coefficient is referenced to the
flap chord c_f = c (1 - x_start), with

    C_halpha = -(c/c_f)^2 I0,   I0 = int_{theta_h}^pi (cos theta_h - cos theta)(1+cos theta) dtheta,
    C_hdelta = -(c/c_f)^2 [ (pi - theta_h)/pi I0 + (2/pi) J ],
    J = int_{theta_h}^pi (cos theta_h - cos theta) (1/2) ln[ sin((theta+theta_h)/2)/sin((theta-theta_h)/2) ] sin theta dtheta.

Sign convention: hinge moment positive trailing-edge down, so a plain flap is
restoring (C_halpha < 0, C_hdelta < 0); Cm_ac_delta < 0 (nose-down for positive
deflection); C_L_delta > 0. Limiting case x_start -> 0 gives C_L_delta -> 2 pi and
C_halpha = C_hdelta -> -pi/2 (the leading-edge moment derivative of a symmetric
airfoil). Screening only: thin-airfoil theory over-predicts flap effectiveness
(no separation) and ignores the finite-span/3-D effects.

definitions.name: effective_gj
definitions.documentation:
Compliance-weighted (harmonic) mean of GJ(y) for the rigid-section screens.

The torsional compliance 1/GJ is averaged over the semi-span, weighted by the local
aeroelastic divergence loading. With e(y) the elastic-axis to aerodynamic-centre
offset (a declared fraction e_frac of the local chord) the strip load is
w(y) = e(y) c(y) = e_frac c(y)^2; the constant e_frac cancels in the ratio, so the
caller passes w(y) = c(y)^2 (see :func:`_effective_gj_for_wing`):

    GJ_eff = (int_0^{b/2} w dy) / (int_0^{b/2} w / GJ(y) dy).

For constant GJ this returns exactly GJ, so the round-1 lumped divergence/reversal
formulae are recovered. ``weight`` is a per-station array aligned with ``gj``.

definitions.name: divergence_pressure
definitions.documentation: Uniform clamped-wing strip screen: q=(pi/2)^2 GJ/(e c a L^2), SI; not flutter.

definitions.name: reversal_pressure
definitions.signature: GJ, lift_control_derivative, moment_control_derivative, chord, lift_slope, semi_span
definitions.documentation: Uniform full-span-control strip screen, SI; negative moment derivative required.

coverage: Test-text reference only; not measured branch/function coverage.

definitions.name: duct_alpha
definitions.documentation: Aspect ratio short/long side (0 < alpha <= 1) of a rectangular duct.

definitions.name: f_re_laminar
definitions.documentation: Shah & London fully developed laminar f·Re (Darcy f) for a rectangular duct; 96 for parallel plates.

definitions.name: nu_laminar_h1
definitions.documentation: Shah & London fully developed laminar Nu_H1 for a rectangular duct heated on all walls; 8.235 for plates.

definitions.name: slot_channel
definitions.signature: q_total_m3_s, n_parallel, area_m2, perimeter_m, width_m, length_m, n_series, oil, one_wall_heated=False
definitions.documentation:
Hydraulics and film coefficient of the slot channels.

q_total_m3_s  total oil flow through the machine
n_parallel    parallel slot channels per cartridge (the flow splits between them)
area_m2       free flow area of one channel; perimeter_m its wetted perimeter
width_m       representative long side of the rectangle, used for the aspect ratio
length_m      channel length per cartridge (the stack length)
n_series      cartridges the flow passes through in series
oil           dict(rho, cp, mu (Pa·s), k)
one_wall_heated  thin gap heated on one wall only (other adiabatic): laminar Nu scaled from the
              Shah & London H1 value by 5.385 / 8.235, their parallel-plate ratio for one wall
              heated at constant flux vs both walls

Returns velocity, Re, Pr, Dh, h (W/m²K), friction factor and pressure drop in Pa. Each
cartridge adds its friction loss plus entry and exit losses (K = 0.5 + 1.0 per channel pass).

definitions.name: oil_flow_for
definitions.documentation: Mass-balance oil flow (m³/s) that carries heat_w at the allowed temperature rise: Q = P / (ρ c_p ΔT).

definitions.name: taylor_couette_h
definitions.documentation:
Air-gap film coefficient (W/m²K) from the Taylor number, with Nu based on hydraulic diameter 2g.

Ta = ω² r g³ / ν². Below Ta = 1708 the gap flow is laminar Couette flow and only conducts
(Nu = 2). Above that, Taylor vortices form and the Becker & Kaye correlation applies.

definitions.name: rotor_temperature
definitions.documentation:
Mean rotor temperature for a dry rotor.

Heat leaves through two parallel paths: gap convection (h·A) and the shaft/bearing
conduction conductance G. T_rotor = T_bore + P / (hA + G).

definitions.name: shaft_conductance
definitions.documentation: Conductance (W/K) of a solid shaft from the rotor to the bearings along n parallel paths: G = n k A / L.

definitions.name: wedge_plate
definitions.signature: dp_pa, span_m, width_m, thickness_m, modulus_pa, tensile_pa
definitions.documentation:
Slot wedge as a simply supported strip spanning the stack under uniform pressure.

Beam of width b, thickness t, span L carrying w = p·b:
  bending stress σ = M/Z = (w L² / 8) / (b t² / 6)
  mid-span deflection δ = 5 w L⁴ / (384 E I), with I = b t³ / 12
Returns stress (Pa), safety factor on tensile strength, and deflection (m).

definitions.name: hoop_stress
definitions.documentation: Thin-wall hoop stress σ = p r / t (Pa) of a ring under internal gauge pressure.

coverage: Test-text reference only; not measured branch/function coverage.
Packaged implementation; no direct test reference found.

definitions.name: normalize_with_corrections
definitions.documentation:
Return (normalized text, corrections) where each correction is dict(index, rule).

Length-changing spellings are unified first; the glyph corrections run last and
are one-for-one character swaps, so their indexes are valid in the returned text.

definitions.name: normalize
definitions.documentation: Map the many OCR spellings of engineering symbols onto one form before matching.

definitions.name: _tolerance
definitions.documentation: Return (plus, minus) in source units from the three tolerance capture groups.

definitions.name: parse
definitions.documentation:
Return dimension records ordered by position in the normalized text.

Each record: kind, text, start, and the fields for its kind
(value_mm / value_deg, tolerance_plus_mm / tolerance_minus_mm, count, pitch_mm).
Records touched by a glyph correction also carry `corrections` (rule names), and
a ± restored from a lone + carries tolerance_ambiguous=True.

coverage: Test-text reference only; not measured branch/function coverage.

definitions.name: SpecError
definitions.documentation: A spec that the compiler must refuse; the message names the offending path.

definitions.name: _finite
definitions.documentation: Require a real finite number (bool is rejected: True would silently mean 1 mm).

definitions.name: _check_value
definitions.documentation: Validate one V (literal, parameter key or linear combination); return keys it reads.

definitions.name: resolve
definitions.documentation: Evaluate one V against concrete parameter values (already validated).

definitions.name: feature_keys
definitions.documentation:
Return the sorted parameter keys one feature reads; also validates its fields.

The compiler uses this exact set as the node's declared parameters, so the CAD
cache key contains every input the builder uses and nothing it does not.

definitions.name: validate
definitions.documentation: Raise SpecError unless the spec is complete, bounded and internally consistent.

definitions.name: _round
definitions.documentation: Quantize a float to the spec precision; -0.0 is normalized so it hashes like 0.0.

definitions.name: canonical
definitions.documentation:
Return a validated copy with every number rounded to precision_mm.

Rounding happens once, here, so float noise from fitting or OCR can never
produce two different recipe identities for the same design intent. Counts
and integer parameters stay integers. Order of parameters and features is
preserved because it is meaningful (form order, feature order).

definitions.name: spec_id
definitions.documentation: SHA-256 of the canonical spec: the reproducibility handle recorded in every report.
